text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... What's with this intensity
and exhaustion?! But still—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"This feels absolutely amazing!
This is—the Classics!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's face brimmed with deep fulfillment
after running her very first Classic race.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
H-How about that, Scarlet!
I was... better than you, weren't I? *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Look who's talking... When you're...
completely out of breath yourself... *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha, look who's talking...
So, how was it? How did it feel running the Oka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I lost, after all... Of course it doesn't
feel good! But...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's totally different... from an ordinary race...
I... just ran in... that "Oka Sho"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Classics she had dreamed of. The joy of standing on that stage must truly be exceptional.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Still, Vodka! Don't go getting cocky just because you beat me in one GⅠ race!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The Tiara road still goes on.
It won't be this easy at the Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha, if you've got that much energy,
our next showdown's gonna be a blast too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, I'll take you on!
Better polish up your skills, though.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Farewell, my rival!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: R-Rival...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph, look at you trying to act all cool!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, looks like your skill
is finally starting to catch up to your snark...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks.
Thanks to you, I was able to beat that guy.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I ran today.
After all, she showed me something truly worth seeing.
choice_data_list: What will you do about the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The Derby...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ah—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A great run at the Oka Sho is cause for celebration.
However, our next choice is just as critical...

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san! What did you and Daiwa Scarlet-san
talk about after the race?

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell us about
your chances of winning the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks)?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, well... Just... keep that kind of stuff loose and casual...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we've gotten ourselves into quite a mess, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I thought all I had to do was chase my dream. But...
sometimes, your dreams just keep multiplying.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Oka Sho behind us, the rivalry
with Daiwa Scarlet holds even greater weight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Derby, or the battle against my rival?
This time, I can't choose both.
choice_data_list: What should we do about the next race for now?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
For now, huh... Then keep it set for the Derby.
However...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let me think about it for a bit.
Actually, why don't you think it through with me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite having won against Daiwa Scarlet,
her expression was dark and heavy.
